title: Closed Space V1.5
description: A space enclosed by walls: its shape a Simple Location - a combination of Right Parallelepipeds - and the Material of its walls. The walls are the faces of the Right Parallelepipeds, named Floor, Ceiling, Front, Back, Left and Right as Right Parallelepiped names them; a face where two Right Parallelepipeds meet is an opening, not a wall. A wall not given its own Material has the DefaultMaterial. Part of a wall - a glass panel in a plaster wall, a door - is a Region of its face, a 2D Right Parallelepiped, with a Material of its own; a door left open is a Region of air (Absorption 0, Transmission 1).

ClosedSpaceSpaceTime.description: Where and when the Closed Space is.

Shape.description: The Simple Location giving the shape of the Closed Space.

Walls.description: The Materials of walls, each a face - or a Region of a face - of one of the Right Parallelepipeds of the Shape.

RightParallelepipedID.description: The Right Parallelepiped of the Shape whose face this wall is.

Region.description: A part of the face, a 2D Right Parallelepiped on it; absent, the whole face. Where Regions of a face overlap, the later one applies.

DefaultMaterial.description: The Material of every wall not given its own.
